Anvers Island lies in the Palmer Archipelago off the western side of the Antarctic Peninsula. Its seascape features towering mountains, extensive glaciers and rocky islets along the coast. The straits around Anvers are included in expedition ship itineraries, and the changing light brings out the textures of snow, ice and stone.

The American research station Palmer is located in a sheltered harbor on the island's southwest coast. Its scientific work is closely linked to the marine ecosystem, including research into krill and food-web relationships with penguins, seals and whales. The surrounding waters offer an insight into the natural setting of these studies, but a visit to the station or a landing is not automatically included and depends on the agreed cruise itinerary.

Apoyo occupies a volcanic crater in Nicaragua. The freshwater lake is surrounded by green slopes, combining views over the water with a mountain landscape. It is a place to linger by the shore after exploring the country's towns and volcanic regions.

Visitors spend time by the water, walking and relaxing at lakeside spots. Apoyo is often included in trips around Granada and Masaya. The lagoon reveals a peaceful side of the volcanic landscape: instead of an open crater, travelers see a broad body of water filling a natural depression.

The Enchanted Aquarium is reached on foot during a trip through the Bom Jardim area. This natural pool is part of a snorkeling experience among fish and aquatic vegetation.

A visit can be combined with the Salobra River and other aquatic sites in the area. The word "Aquarium" refers here to a natural pool, not an enclosed urban exhibition.

Visitors come to Aquiraz for its long stretch of sand and the open Atlantic Ocean. The resort coastline of Brazil's Ceará state lies close to Fortaleza. It is easy to imagine a holiday here that starts with a morning walk along the beach and leaves plenty of time for sea air and activities throughout the day.

One of Aquiraz's best-known beach areas is Porto das Dunas. Its broad shoreline, surf and resort hotels make it a convenient starting point for time by the water. Take a stroll along the ocean, watch the waves leave thin white lines on wet sand, and choose a spot for a leisurely lunch after your walk. Swimming conditions should be assessed on site, as this is an open-ocean coastline.

Porto das Dunas is home to Beach Park. Water slides and other attractions add a separate family activity to a beach holiday. You can plan a visit to the water park in advance, choosing a suitable format and confirming the arrangements. This makes Aquiraz appealing both to travelers who enjoy quiet seaside walks and to families with children looking for more to do.

Another name on the local coast is Prainha. Exploring the different beaches helps you find your own favorite place to relax. Aquiraz is well suited to a seaside extension of a trip through Brazil: after cities and sightseeing routes, you can devote several days to sand, sun and ocean.
